say:1:1623236001:1.text: So, how are those two magical creations doing? Let me guess. It hasn't been... quiet.
say:1:1623236001:1.source_cn: 那两个魔法造物的情况怎么样？我猜，应该没少出乱子吧？

say:3:1623236002:1.text: In the woods this close to the Serene Lyceum... magical creations trying to blend in with the animals—now that's something I've never seen before.
say:3:1623236002:1.source_cn: 森林离莱希拉姆这么近，魔法造物居然会主动尝试融入动物群...
say:3:1623236002:1.male: In the woods this close to the Serene Lyceum... magical creations trying to blend in with the animals—now that's something I've never seen before.
say:3:1623236002:1.female: In the woods this close to the Serene Lyceum... magical creations trying to blend in with the animals—now that's something I've never seen before.

say:4:1623236003:1.text: No matter how it ends, the fact that they're willing to make contact and to adjust already means a lot for both sides.
say:4:1623236003:1.source_cn: 不管结果如何，只要它们愿意开始接触、开始磨合，对双方来...
say:4:1623236003:1.male: No matter how it ends, the fact that they're willing to make contact and to adjust already means a lot for both sides.
say:4:1623236003:1.female: No matter how it ends, the fact that they're willing to make contact and to adjust already means a lot for both sides.

say:5:1623236004:1.text: This has never happened before. Even I can't say for sure where it will lead.
say:5:1623236004:1.source_cn: 这件事前所未有，就连我也不清楚事情的走向会是怎样的。
say:5:1623236004:1.male: This has never happened before. Even I can't say for sure where it will lead.
say:5:1623236004:1.female: This has never happened before. Even I can't say for sure where it will lead.

say:6:1623236005:1.text: So, keep an eye on them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1623236005:1.male: So, keep an eye on them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1623236005:1.female: So, keep an eye on them, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:7:1623236006:1.text: But don't force it. They need to figure it out themselves, and the process is what makes it count.
say:7:1623236006:1.source_cn: 不过不用太刻意去干预。这条路需要他们自己走通才有意义。
say:7:1623236006:1.male: But don't force it. They need to figure it out themselves, and the process is what makes it count.
